decision: Use an offline, provenance-bound Qubes resource calibration collector and apply measured p95 RAM plus declared vCPU profiles to the existing resource-aware fleet evaluator.

reviews.preferred: Bind samples to exact git SHA, topology ID, run ID, worker ID and capability profile; fail closed on drift or insufficient samples.
reviews.reason: Synthetic planning numbers must not be mistaken for deployment evidence, and mixed runs can understate resource requirements.

reviews.preferred: Keep calibration read-only/offline and reject malformed framing, unexpected workers and profile changes.
reviews.reason: Avoids adding a privileged daemon or weakening Qubes/qrexec controls merely to collect capacity evidence.

reviews.preferred: Collect bounded samples and use p95 RAM/CPU summaries without adding worker/coordinator runtime traffic beyond the calibration workload.
reviews.reason: Linear local aggregation has negligible overhead and leaves MissionQueue and coordinator semantics unchanged.

alternativesRejected.failure: Fast but not evidence of real Qubes memory/CPU pressure.
Higher attack surface, lifecycle complexity and resource overhead before qualification needs it.
Too sensitive to noise and can mis-rank fleet topologies.

lesson: Resource budgets become readiness evidence only after measurements are bound to the exact code and topology being qualified; until then they remain planning assumptions.
